6 per VCO core drawn as 'CAP' with no value (timing/integrator caps and supply decoupling)
polarized supply caps on the edge-connector sheet, no value
transistor array, two drawn per VCO core (both as Q?A, pins 1-5)
matched transistor array, one per VCO core
quad op amp, one per VCO core
dual op amp, one per VCO core
dual OTA shared: section A in VCO1, section B in VCO2
pot across the LM336 reference, unnamed, no value drawn
